property_summary: For any caller and any timestamp/ether amount where the call is accepted, after calling fallback with exactly 10 ether and block.timestamp greater than prior pastBlockTime, the contract's public pastBlockTime equals the current block.timestamp; the mutant that writes block.number instead will cause pastBlockTime != block.timestamp for inputs where block.timestamp != block.number.
change_summary: Change update of pastBlockTime to set it to block.number instead of block.timestamp, altering the stored value returned by the public getter.
